welcome.title: Where passion meets Patagonian nature.
welcome.body: Set on 40 acres (16 hectares), 5 miles (8 km) from Coyhaique and on the banks of the Coyhaique River, your trip unfolds against a backdrop of natural splendor: a refuge for anglers and nature lovers alike.
welcome.img_alt: Fly angler beside a waterfall on a river in Aysén

history.title: More than two decades building a Patagonian tradition.
history.p1: Coyhaique River Lodge was born from a simple conviction: Patagonia is best experienced up close, unhurried, and with people who have known its rivers, forests and seasons for generations. Two decades later, that same conviction still guides every season, every itinerary and every guest who arrives looking for more than a vacation.

gastro.title: Patagonian cooking and energy for the whole day.
gastro.body: At CRL, the table is part of the program. We work with seasonal products from the Aysén region, and every menu is designed to support long days outdoors: complete dishes, good hydration and trail food for the river, the mountain or the lake.
